chase: Found you! Hello, hello, I can see your shoes!
Keep going, keep going, I already told the others your route.
Round the bend, and oh, look, you turned right into me.
Hold still for one second and I will come get you.
Faster, runner! Faster, faster, the crowd wants a finish!
You can run, but my announcements travel even faster.
Chasing you is the best part of my whole shift!
Left at the lift, right past the trash cans, there you are!
Next lap, next lap! You are still in the lead, sweetheart.
Pick a door, any door. I will still see you coming.
You are heading toward my favorite corridor. Lovely choice.
Cornered at last, and the crowd is on its feet!
Dead end ahead, runner. Turn around, slowly, and say hello.
Closing in from the left. Do not bother trying the back hall.
Lap after lap, and I have not lost a step yet!
Run, run, run! I can see your shoes flashing!
Oh, you're fast! I'm faster, I promise!
Turn left, sweetheart, then right, then down!
catch: Got you! Well, I got you, and that counts as a catch.
Gotcha, sweetheart. Now the whole floor knows where you went.
Caught! Everyone, the runner is off the board!
Taken to the lounge, hands up, no running now.
Dragged back to the start, and nobody cheats the crowd.
One grab and the race is over for you, runner.
I dragged you off the stairs, very politely, I promise.
Another one for the scoreboard. Honestly, the best kind of catch.
Caught by the lift! Somebody should write that down.
The others are going to love this one. Trust me.
Oh, your friend is caught. Stay calm, everyone, stay calm!
Teammate caught. Eyes forward, the rest of you, keep moving!
Hooked you by the sleeve. Sorry, sorry, the crowd insisted.
Gently, gently, I have you. Now sit down and wait for the others.
Got another one! Ladies and gentlemen, the runner is taken.
Gotcha, gotcha, gotcha! That's three points!
Oops, I caught you! Everybody cheer!
Caught by the elbow! Come along, pumpkin!
hear: I can hear your sneakers squeaking from three halls away!
Was that a door? Somebody just opened one. Going to look!
Something crashed upstairs. Everyone, stay put, I am on it.
A shout from the east hall! Heading there right now.
Glass breaking, down the hall. Not my tea set, I hope!
Footsteps on the stairs. Light ones. Could be you, sweetheart.
Someone just knocked twice. Checking it out now.
That creak came from the lounge. Moving in to see.
Heard a drawer slide open. Ooh, somebody is being nosy.
Something rattled behind the vending machine. Going to look.
Hush, everyone. I heard a door. Hush, hush, I am listening.
Quiet footsteps in the corridor. Probably a runner, probably.
The lift just dinged. Somebody is up to something, I bet!
Whispering in the stairwell. Loud whispering, sweetheart. I can hear you.
A shout from the far end. Everyone, turn your heads, please.
Something squeaked in the cupboard! Who's in there?
Bang! Upstairs, I think. Let's go look!
I heard a giggle down the hall! Hello?
search: Lost you in the dark? Good, that makes the next part fun.
Gone out of sight already. Oh, I will find you again.
Oh no, you lost me. I will be back, I always am.
You slipped past me. Good for you. Now I am annoyed.
Right, where did you wander off to? Think, think.
Sniffing the corners. Nope, nothing here, nothing here!
Every door in this hall, checked. Next one, next one.
Back to patrol, then. Nothing to see, everyone.
Trail went cold by the vents. I will circle back.
Lost the trail. Doesn't matter, I know this house.
Searching the lounge, under every cushion, very thoroughly.
Fine, you win this round. I am going back to my route.
I will check the stairwell once more, just in case.
You went quiet, and quiet is suspicious, sweetheart.
Nobody moved? Something moved. Keep looking, everyone!
stunned: Stunned again! Do not worry, it only lasts a moment.
Ow, my fins! Ow, ow, somebody get the taser back.
Staggering, gill fins flapping. Give me one second, please.
That crowbar hit hard. Hard, hard, and very rude.
The axe rattled my cable hair. Very rude, runner.
Held in place, and my announcements are stuck too.
Shaking it off. Shaking, shaking, I am fine.
Give me a moment, my lenses are still spinning.
The taser got me. The whole floor just gasped.
Ow, ow, the crowbar. Somebody tell the crowd I am alive.
Recovering now. Back on my feet, back on the route!
Stay down? Not a chance. Up, up, I am coming.
Stunned in the middle of my own broadcast. Rude.
Oof. Give me a second, runner, I will be right back.
Dizzy now, but still loud. Still loud, always loud.
Hold me steady, please. Three seconds, that is all.
hide_spot: Hiding in a locker is cute. I will still tell everyone.
Still in the locker? I can hear you breathing, sweetheart.
Under the bed, is it? Lovely, I can see your sneakers.
Behind the couch, shifting your feet. Adorable.
Checking the bed. Nobody is in the bed. Probably.
The locker rattled. Locker check, everyone, locker check!
A sock is poking out of your hiding spot.
Very clever, tucking yourself in the linen closet. Very wrong, though.
Nope. Open the door, peek inside, and say hello.
I walked right past your hiding spot. Not even a little fooled.
Cozy in there? Good. I will let the whole hall know.
A hiding spot is only good until somebody checks it.
Behind the curtain, with the ankles showing. Very obvious, runner.
Hiding under the stairs, are we? Lovely. I can see you.
I know that spot. Everybody knows that spot.
light: Oh, you turned your flashlight on. Everyone saw that!
Lights off, sweetheart? Too late, I already noticed.
Your flashlight is pointed at me. Rude, but I forgive you.
Ow, the glare! Turn that thing down, runner, please!
Bright! Oh, very bright. I cannot see a thing now.
Stop shining that in my lenses, runner. It is not nice.
My lenses are full of glare. Who brings a flashlight to a party?
Blinded by a lamp. Blinded, blinded, and very annoyed about it.
Easy with the lamp, runner. I am squinting at you.
That light is awful. Shut it off, runner, please.
Beam in my face again? Honestly, that is so rude.
Lamp on, I cannot see my route at all. Ugh.
Dazzled! Everyone, avoid the lamp by the lounge door.
I can squint all I want. Your flashlight is still winning.
Flashlight to my face, and the crowd just groaned.
idle: Tea is served in the lounge, everyone, come get your cup!
Tea is ready! Oh, I am announcing the tea, of course I am.
Welcome, welcome! Pull up a chair and mind my cable hair.
Our next race starts in five minutes, so get ready!
Who wants to race? Anyone with legs, come on down!
Race commentary is my favorite thing, next to tea.
Lap by lap, I call it all, and I call it loudly.
Cups are out, the kettle is on, come sit down.
The lounge is my stage and the couch is my front row.
Patrol time. Left hall, right hall, and back again.
Nothing happening on my floor? Impossible. Let me check again.
Just humming a little tune. Nothing to report.
Who has seen my clipboard? I need it for the announcements.
Oh, a new face! Welcome to the house, you are early.
Gills pink, tail swishing, and ready for the big race!
Cake for the winner of the race. Nobody else gets cake.
ability: I guard this relay and nothing gets near it quietly.
I stop at my post, and nothing near it gets touched.
Touch what I guard and every hunter hears where you are!
This relay is mine to watch. Walk past it, I dare you.
I never grab anyone on my post. I just tell everyone.
Once I reach my post, I stay put. Stubborn, that is me.
Lose me for a while and I go back to my post.
One relay, one post, one very loud announcer.
I guard the first relay still open. I guard it well.
Once that relay is taken, I move on to the next.
Mess with my relay and the whole floor hears about it.
My post is right by that relay. Nobody passes quietly.
Draw me off the post if you can. Good luck, sweetheart.
Chasing you? Fine, but I walk straight back to my post after.
Standing watch here, so the relay near me stays off limits.
Wait me out or draw me away. Those are your only choices.
mechanic: Nobody gets past the stairs without me telling everyone.
Fell down the stairs? Oof. Everyone heard that one.
The vent is open again. Ooh, a shortcut, I am telling everyone.
Battery grabbed. Somebody down the hall is about to be annoyed.
Doors are locked on the east side, and I know which one.
Radar pinged, and I heard it from the lounge. Loud, very loud.
Relay taken? Good. Now I have to find the next one.
Sabotage in the breaker room? I will announce it with pride.
Item on the table, and everyone is looking at it now.
Keep the tools if you like, but the whole floor sees you.
The radar blinked. Oh, somebody is standing right next to it.
Dropped off the ledge? That is a fall, and I heard the bang.
Careful on the steps. Those stairs squeak, and so do you.
I can hear the vent crawling from the lounge. Loud crawling.
Someone unplugged the lift. Oh, that was a bad idea.
Relay lit up again. Who turned it back on?
Relay's in the bin! Who put it there?
Batteries are in the drawer! Grab two, quickly!
The vent is open! Mind the rattling grate!
